description: Two hands with two different dancers, pulling by each one in turn.

walkthrough.line: Right hand to the one you face and pull by, left to the next one and pull by.
walkthrough.teach: Give your {firstHand} hand to the dancer you are facing and pull by, going straight past them. Give your {secondHand} hand to the dancer you are facing now and pull by again. Two hands with two different people, and you end facing out of where you started.
